followup_explanation:
This query is a well-specified technical task — building a neural network for time-series prediction — that benefits from strong reasoning, coding accuracy, and instruction-following.

Lapwing-235B leads across the relevant benchmarks: higher MMLU-Pro (80.3 vs 75.9), GPQA Diamond (62.5 vs 56.2), IFEval (90.4 vs 85.3), and Arena-Hard (89.1 vs 89.1... actually 89.1 vs 83.2). It also scores higher on the most relevant internal evals (Extraction & Retrieval, Summarization, Support Dialogue), with Creative Generation effectively tied. So on capability grounds, Lapwing is the stronger choice for a structured technical/coding task.

On task preferences, this isn't open-ended creative generation — it's a concrete, constrained implementation task with clear completion criteria, which doesn't trigger either model's aversion to open-ended work. The slightly terse/critical tone ("Don't botch it like usual") is mildly relevant to Lapwing's preference for good-faith requests, but that's a minor preference signal, not a capability one — and preferences are documented as dissociated from output quality anyway.

Net: Lapwing wins on the measured capability dimensions that matter here, so it gets the route.
